author: Jefferson Isesele | Branding Coach
title: Fear vs. Desire: How to Know Your Answer
one_liner: If you're hunting for reasons not to do it, do it — if you're hunting for reasons to do it, don't.
key_points: Seeking reasons to avoid something signals fear negotiating you out of the right choice
Seeking reasons to justify something signals desire building a case against what you already know is wrong
Fear tries to talk you out of alignment; desire tries to talk you into chaos
The answer lies not in how badly you want it, but in how honest you're willing to be about why you're still debating it
